chunks: From him, from Isma'il ibn 'Isa, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a hired worker who disobeys his employer: is it lawful to strike him or not?
So he عليه السلام replied: “It is not lawful for you to strike him. If he suits you, keep him; otherwise, let him go.”

key_terms.فَخَلِّ عَنْهُ: leave him or let him go
key_terms.يَعْصِي: disobeys or acts contrary to instructions

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to strike a hired worker who disobeys his employer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal and ethical ruling concerning the treatment of a hired worker. Imam Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام forbids striking the worker and instructs that if the worker is acceptable he may be retained, otherwise he should be dismissed, affirming restraint and proper conduct in labor relations.
